dir_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The `DIRECTION` pin of the A4988 stepper driver.

*See also: [Stepper Component](https://esphome.io/components/stepper#a4988-component)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Specify the ID of the stepper so that you can control it.

*See also: [Stepper Component](https://esphome.io/components/stepper#a4988-component)*

sleep_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: Optionally also use the `SLEEP` pin of the A4988 stepper driver. If specified, the driver will be put into sleep mode as soon as the stepper reaches the target steps.

*See also: [Stepper Component](https://esphome.io/components/stepper#a4988-component)*

step_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The `STEP` pin of the A4988 stepper driver.

*See also: [Stepper Component](https://esphome.io/components/stepper#a4988-component)*
